source: The costs of running a domme, sex work or kink practice, with a plain word on whether a return usually carries each. General shape of the ordinary and necessary business expense rule; nothing here is advice about your return.
confidenceNote: deductible says how a tax pro who knows the work usually treats the kind: usually, sometimes (clothing and grooming are the classic argument: the test is whether it is unsuitable for daily life), or ask. The tax page counts only usually; it shows what changes if sometimes is allowed.
note: Platform and processor fees are not a kind here on purpose. They are computed on the Streams page from each stream, so they are never typed twice.
